title: Amazing Grace
short: Traditional hymn tune “New Britain” (wor · G 3/4 · listen, then play it.
trouble: Reading notes one at a time instead of in chunks.

blocks.html: Count three beats in each bar. The tune starts with one pickup note on beat 3, before the first full bar. In bar 7 the melody climbs to the D above the staff: move your right hand up for it, and back down in bar 10.
What to notice: Hymn tune from the early 1800s, set to Newton’s words in The Southern Harmony (1835)

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys light up, and “wait for me” lets you practise one hand at a time.

blocks.html: Play through it once with the right hand only, then add the left. Which chord change made you stop?

sources.name: Melody checked note by note against the Mutopia Project’s “New Britain” hymn setting (SATB, from cyberhymnal.org, public domain). The left hand is our own, simplified from that setting’s bass line. History from Wikipedia.
